Hi everyone, hope, everyone is having a good day

My last 5 charts to complete the 20 with multiple touches, I have to say this section of 20 trades was by far the most challenging, with working out all the nuances and different formations that appear, considering I have yet to study them as fully as I have with the FLs...

The next chart is of the hourly, and this is just to show the FL I was working with before going down to the LTFs

Next up is the 15 minute showing all the P.A I recognised...

The next chart is the 15 minute chart with a FL limit on and different variations of P.A I can see.

Next chart is the 15 minute TF, the FL however has been taken from the hourly, I have noted P.A on the chart.

Do you see at the bottom of my 15 minute chart above, I wrote 'Engulf here, or is it an FO?' I remember reading something that Pedini wrote sometime back regarding whether price has made an FO or an Engulf, so I decided to look on the 4hr chart, to see where price was in relation my 15 minutes chart, I found (chart below) that there was a FL and it seemed price had produced a FO, just below the FL...

I may be well out especially relating to the FO and engulf scenario, but to me it made sense, if anyone sees anything I may not be seeing, would be great to hear.

Now onto my next set of 20, I believe on the article the last section is to find and chart 20 flag limits that failed to hold price on first or subsequent return - note the PA, and where price then went (copied from the actual article)
